headline: Jio's record IPO details land and Anthropic's revenue surge headlines a day when hot US inflation rattled Asian AI stocks, while Andhra Pradesh sets local body poll dates.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh announces local body poll schedule
stories.summary: The State Election Commission said 13 Municipal Corporations and 87 Municipalities go to polls on October 28, with panchayat polls in three phases.
stories.why_it_matters: Direct impact on Andhra Pradesh politics, your home state.

stories.title: NDA partners yet to agree on seat-sharing in AP local polls
stories.summary: Talks have stalled over Mayor posts, with parties holding firm on seats and posts. A decision is likely in two days.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows how the ruling alliance in AP is holding together ahead of the polls.

stories.title: ECI extends SIR deadline in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: The notice phase and disposal of claims and objections now run to October 22. Final electoral rolls will be published on October 30.
stories.why_it_matters: Affects voter roll accuracy in your state, and you may want to check your own entry.

stories.title: ED attaches ₹129.85 crore in TTD ghee adulteration case
stories.summary: The ED attached assets of three dairy firms, their promoters and related entities.
stories.why_it_matters: Major development in a high-profile Andhra Pradesh case involving Tirumala temple.

stories.title: Revanth Reddy warns energy officials over power interruptions
stories.summary: The Telangana CM threatened action, including suspensions, if power interruptions are reported. Separately, Harish Rao alleged farms get under 8 hours of interrupted supply.
stories.why_it_matters: Power supply is a live political issue in Telangana.

stories.title: Supreme Court to hear INDIA bloc plea against SIR
stories.summary: The court is likely to hear Rahul Gandhi and INDIA bloc leaders' plea against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
stories.why_it_matters: Could shape how voter roll revisions proceed nationwide, including in your states.

stories.title: SC upholds quashing of Tamil Nadu reservation for converts to Islam
stories.summary: The Supreme Court upheld the Madras High Court order quashing the notification. It said the government order created an 'artificial group' accessing backward-class benefits.
stories.why_it_matters: An important reservation ruling.

stories.title: SC makes insurance mandatory on all train tickets from Oct 27
stories.summary: Insurance, already optional for online tickets, becomes mandatory for tickets bought at station counters from October 27, 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: A direct change for rail travellers.

stories.title: US inflation rises more than expected to 3.7%
stories.summary: US inflation rose to 3.7% in the year to September, driven by higher motor fuel costs.
stories.why_it_matters: It revived rate fears and hit global equities, including emerging markets like India.

stories.title: Ukraine hit by Starlink throttling
stories.summary: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but speed limits still disrupt its drone missions. Musk suggested the US government may be behind the slowdown.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows how dependent the war is on private infrastructure.

stories.title: Drone attacks sink ships in the Black Sea
stories.summary: Suspected Russian drones have sunk or damaged 5 ships near Bulgaria and Romania. NATO may redeploy anti-drone defenses.
stories.why_it_matters: The conflict is widening to NATO's borders.

stories.title: IMF warns on Asia growth
stories.summary: The IMF said Asia's growth may slow to 4.4% in 2027 on energy price shocks, Middle East conflict, AI market correction risks and rising bond yields.
stories.why_it_matters: Frames the macro risks for India and your investments.

stories.title: Istanbul floods kill a teenager
stories.summary: Heavy rain collapsed roads and flooded hospitals in Turkiye's largest city, shutting schools and halting traffic.
stories.why_it_matters: A major weather disaster.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands strike across Ireland
stories.summary: Public sector workers are on strike in a pay dispute with the Irish government.
stories.why_it_matters: A large labour action in a country with a big tech and Indian-worker presence.

stories.title: Sensex jumps 1,100 points, Nifty near 22,950
stories.summary: Benchmarks rebounded on Thursday after the previous day's fall, helped by IT and banking stocks and a drop in oil prices.
stories.why_it_matters: It gives context for your index-fund holdings.

stories.title: Nifty IT up 9% in three sessions
stories.summary: IT stocks rose up to 3.5% on strong HCLTech and TCS results, AI services optimism and a weaker rupee.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals sentiment toward your sector's employers.

stories.title: Nikkei plunges nearly 5% on AI stock selloff
stories.summary: AI-linked stocks fell on concerns over CoreWeave's finances and hot US inflation. SoftBank fell 9.4%, and Advantest and Tokyo Electron dropped 13.9% and 7.3%. Oracle's 5-year CDS also widened to a record 288 bps.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals rising stress around AI infrastructure financing.

stories.title: Government to sell 60.72% of IDBI Bank to Fairfax for ₹52,877 crore
stories.summary: The government decided to sell its stake to Canada's Fairfax Financial Holdings. IDBI shares fell about 6% on the news.
stories.why_it_matters: A major bank privatisation.

stories.title: EPF partial withdrawal rules explained
stories.summary: New rules group partial withdrawals into essential needs, housing and special circumstances, with a 12-month minimum membership.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to your PF planning.

stories.title: Cabinet skips July 2026 DA decision
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet did not announce the DA hike, but approved a railway bonus and a social assistance plan.
stories.why_it_matters: Matters for central employees' pay and general salary benchmarks.

stories.title: Tax relief on US stock dividends in India
stories.summary: Dividends from US stocks arrive after US withholding tax but are again fully taxable in India. Relief can be claimed.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful if you hold US stocks or funds.

stories.title: Largecaps shrinking, smallcaps growing in market share
stories.summary: Domestic institutions are tilting toward mid and small caps while large caps face foreign selling.
stories.why_it_matters: Informs index-fund allocation thinking.

stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO: ₹1,065–₹1,119 band, opens Oct 21
stories.summary: The IPO opens October 21 and closes October 23, with a fresh issue of up to ₹30,213 crore. The upper band implies about ₹10.3 lakh crore valuation, the largest IPO in India's history. ₹2,500 crore is reserved for RIL shareholders, with record date October 14.
stories.why_it_matters: The biggest IPO in Indian history.

stories.title: Zetwerk raises ₹2,251 crore from anchors ahead of IPO
stories.summary: The manufacturing company raised the amount from anchor investors before its issue opens.
stories.why_it_matters: An active IPO on the calendar.

stories.title: Tonbo Imaging raises ₹255 crore from anchors; bidding opens Oct 15
stories.summary: The defence tech startup's public issue opens for bidding on October 15.
stories.why_it_matters: A defence-tech IPO opens.

stories.title: Anthropic Q3 revenue up 45% to $16.8 billion ahead of IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic's quarterly revenue rose 45% to $16.8 billion, after $4.7 billion and $11.6 billion in the first two quarters. It targets a valuation above $2 trillion despite large operating losses.
stories.why_it_matters: A key signal for the AI industry and its IPO market.

stories.title: OpenAI: next AI phase is about outcomes
stories.summary: OpenAI's Pragya Misra said the work is now going to boards and CEOs to solve specific problems and report results to investors.
stories.why_it_matters: It describes the forward-deployed work you are aiming for.

stories.title: The AI race is back on
stories.summary: The Verge says Anthropic and OpenAI had pulled ahead, but rivals such as Google and Meta are again contending.
stories.why_it_matters: Matters for which platforms to build on.

stories.title: FSB calls for human oversight of agentic AI
stories.summary: The Financial Stability Board issued final guidance for banks and firms on managing agentic AI risks.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to fintech agent deployments.

stories.title: Eight US states sue OpenAI over child safety
stories.summary: Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana filed separate suits alleging ChatGPT harms kids and misleads customers.
stories.why_it_matters: Regulatory risk for the leading AI vendor.

stories.title: McKinsey tests AI client simulation in interviews
stories.summary: Some entry-level candidates will hold a 10-minute conversation with an AI simulated client.
stories.why_it_matters: A sign of how AI is changing hiring.

stories.title: Netflix TimeSeries tiered storage: Kafka/Flink to Cassandra cold reads
stories.summary: Netflix describes moving multi-petabyte time series data from hot storage to cheaper tiers.
stories.why_it_matters: Directly relevant to Kafka and distributed storage work.

stories.title: Netflix Conductor: The Next Chapter
stories.summary: Netflix discussed the future of its workflow orchestration engine after ending maintenance of the open-source version.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to microservice orchestration design.

stories.title: Hillel Wayne on finding resilience bugs with formal methods
stories.summary: The talk covers property strength, state-space verification and 'adversarial non-determinism' for reasoning about distributed system failures.
stories.why_it_matters: Practical mental models for distributed systems.

stories.title: Fridge hack hit 700 supermarkets
stories.summary: The incident exploited outdated devices exposed to the Internet, costing millions and sparking fires.
stories.why_it_matters: A reminder of the cost of basic security failures.

stories.title: Netflix to cut 1,000 jobs
stories.summary: The cuts are about 6% of its global workforce and its steepest since 2022.
stories.why_it_matters: A hiring-market signal from a big tech employer.

stories.title: Centre preparing a data centre policy
stories.summary: Minister of State Jitin Prasada said the policy is coming amid concerns about power costs.
stories.why_it_matters: Affects India's AI infrastructure build-out.

stories.title: West Indies beat India by 24 runs to level T20I series 2-2
stories.summary: Chasing 248 in Hyderabad, India lost despite Sanju Samson's 56 off 23. Samson called Tilak's wicket the turning point. India now play the decider unchanged, bowling first.
stories.why_it_matters: The series is on the line at your home ground.

stories.title: Natarajan returns to SRH, Ansari goes to DC
stories.summary: Natarajan rejoins SRH at INR 5 crore, and Ansari moves to Delhi Capitals at INR 40 lakh.
stories.why_it_matters: IPL trade news.
